description: [STAGE 1: ARCHITECT] Search and retrieve complete layout scaffolds (Workspace Dashboard, Auth Split-Screen, Data Table Detail, Workspace Settings, Pricing, etc.) with explicit slot markers, grid structures, and responsive containers. Next step: Call basecoat_rules_enforcer and basecoat_creative_director, then basecoat_compose_stack or basecoat_component_syntax.

block.description: Specific block identifier or pattern to retrieve scaffold for (e.g. "sidebar-01".."sidebar-16", "dashboard-01".."dashboard-07", "login-01").

componentId.description: Alternative recipe or block identifier alias.

density.description: Visual layout density: "comfortable" (standard SaaS spacing, p-6/h-14) or "compact" (dense data tools, p-4/h-12).

id.description: Alternative recipe or block identifier alias matching id or recipe.

intent.description: User or business intent for page scaffolding (e.g. "workspace-dashboard", "executive-dashboard", "sidebar-07", "data-table-detail", "auth-split-flow").

name.description: Alternative recipe or block identifier alias.

recipe.description: Macro recipe identifier to resolve directly (e.g. "workspace-dashboard", "workspace-detail", "workspace-settings", "auth-split-flow").

name: basecoat_page_architect
